// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title IERC20Minimal
 * @notice Zero-dep minimal ERC20 surface used by the Sidiora Meta-AG stack.
 * @dev Introduced in Phase 3 (Task 3.1) as the first internal consumer of ERC20
 *      view/transfer semantics beyond oracle reads. Later phases (engine,
 *      adapters, router) reuse this interface verbatim to keep the meta-ag
 *      layer free of external dependencies.
 *
 *      This file is scoped to `contracts/meta-ag/` and does not expand the
 *      Phase 1 frozen public surface — it is an internal utility interface.
 */
interface IERC20Minimal {
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);

    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);

    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);

    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
}

contracts/meta-ag/interfaces/IPECORVault.content:
// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title IPECORVault
 * @notice Interface for PECORVault v2 — single multi-asset vault holding all non-Sidiora
 *         liquidity. Operator-gated pull/push. UUPS-upgradeable, Timelock-admin.
 * @dev Spec §7.5. Replaces live vault at
 *      0x6500B1B3F8067772041C68b2c51D8E7A84e20C31 via Migration Path M1.
 *
 * USDL registration invariant (spec §7.5):
 *   USDL MUST be registered via registerToken(USDL, true) before the first
 *   vault-adjacent swap. Without this, the vault cannot bridge between
 *   Sidiora and vault liquidity.
 */
interface IPECORVault {

    struct TokenInfo {
        bool isRegistered;
        bool isStablecoin;
        uint8 decimals;
        uint256 reserves;
        uint256 totalDeposited;
        uint256 totalWithdrawn;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Initialize the UUPS proxy (spec §7.5)
     * @param weth Wrapped native coin address (WPAX on Paxeer)
     * @param tracker ITransactionTracker address (may be zero at bootstrap)
     * @param admin Timelock address — granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
     */
    function initialize(address weth, address tracker, address admin) external;

    function registerToken(address token, bool isStablecoin) external;

    function setStablecoinStatus(address token, bool isStablecoin) external;

    function setOperator(address operator, bool authorized) external;

    function setTransactionTracker(address tracker) external;

    function emergencyWithdraw(address token, uint256 amount, address recipient) external;

    function syncReserves(address token) external;

    function syncAllReserves() external;

    /// @notice Inventory donation; creates no depositor shares or withdrawal entitlement.
    function deposit(address token, uint256 amount) external;

    function depositBatch(address[] calldata tokenList, uint256[] calldata amounts) external;

    /// @notice Wrap native coin into WETH and credit reserves (WETH must be registered).
    function depositNative() external payable;

    /**
     * @notice Pull tokens from `from` into the vault (fee-on-transfer safe).
     * @return actualAmount Amount actually received after any token-side fees.
     */
    function pullTokens(
        address token,
        address from,
        uint256 amount
    ) external returns (uint256 actualAmount);

    function pushTokens(address token, address to, uint256 amount) external;

    /// @notice Unwrap WETH to native coin and forward to recipient.
    function withdrawNative(uint256 amount, address to) external;

    function updateReserves(
        address tokenIn,
        uint256 amountIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountOut
    ) external;

    /// @notice Reserve refundable escrow/fees against free inventory, owned by the caller.
    function reserveTokens(address token, uint256 amount) external;
    function releaseTokens(address token, uint256 amount) external;
    function getAvailableReserves(address token) external view returns (uint256);
    function getReservedBalance(address token) external view returns (uint256);

    function getReserves(address token) external view returns (uint256);

    /// @dev Flat-tuple return preserves live ABI compatibility. Use getTokenInfo; no tokens() auto-getter exists.
    function getTokenInfo(
        address token
    )
        external
        view
        returns (
            bool isRegistered,
            bool isStablecoin,
            uint8 decimals,
            uint256 reserves,
            uint256 totalDeposited,
            uint256 totalWithdrawn
        );

    function isStablecoin(address token) external view returns (bool);

    function getTokenDecimals(address token) external view returns (uint8);

    function getRegisteredTokens() external view returns (address[] memory);

    function getRegisteredStablecoins() external view returns (address[] memory);

    function getRegisteredTokenCount() external view returns (uint256);

    function hasLiquidity(address token, uint256 amount) external view returns (bool);

    function getAllReserves() external view returns (address[] memory, uint256[] memory);

    function getUntrackedFunds(address token) external view returns (uint256);

    event TokenRegistered(address indexed token, uint8 decimals, bool isStablecoin);
    event StablecoinStatusUpdated(address indexed token, bool isStablecoin);
    event Deposit(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed depositor,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve
    );
    event Withdrawal(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed recipient,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve
    );
    event NativeDeposit(address indexed depositor, uint256 amount, uint256 newReserve);
    event NativeWithdrawal(address indexed recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 newReserve);
    event OperatorUpdated(address indexed operator, bool authorized);
    event TransactionTrackerUpdated(address indexed tracker);
    event ReservesUpdated(address indexed token, uint256 oldReserve, uint256 newReserve);
    event ReservesSync(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 oldReserves,
        uint256 newReserves,
        uint256 recovered
    );
    event EmergencyWithdraw(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed recipient,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve
    );
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title IPriceOracle
 * @notice Interface for the Paxeer Price Oracle — multi-relayer, staleness-protected, TWAP-enabled
 * @dev All prices use 18 decimal precision (PRICE_DECIMALS = 18).
 *
 * Architecture (spec §7.1):
 *   - Off-chain relayers push prices via batchUpdatePrices()
 *   - On-chain staleness protection reverts getPrice() if data is too old
 *   - TWAP (Time-Weighted Average Price) computed on-chain from price history
 *   - Price bounds prevent erroneous updates (e.g., relayer bug pushing price to 0)
 */
interface IPriceOracle {

    struct PriceData {
        uint256 price;
        uint256 timestamp;
        uint256 roundId;
        address relayer;
    }

    struct TokenConfig {
        bool isRegistered;
        uint256 heartbeatInterval;
        uint256 deviationThresholdBps; // Off-chain minimum publication trigger; NOT an enforced jump limit.
        uint256 maxPriceBound;
        uint256 minPriceBound;
        uint256 maxStaleness;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Initialize the UUPS proxy (spec §7.1)
     * @param admin Timelock — granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
     */
    function initialize(address admin) external;

    /**
     * @notice Get the latest price for a token
     * @dev REVERTS if price is stale (older than maxStaleness for that token)
     * @param token The token address to get the price for
     * @return price The token price in USD with 18 decimals
     */
    function getPrice(address token) external view returns (uint256 price);

    /**
     * @notice Get the latest price with full metadata
     * @dev REVERTS if price is stale
     * @param token The token address
     * @return price The token price (18 decimals)
     * @return timestamp When the price was last updated
     * @return roundId The round number of this price update
     */
    function getPriceWithTimestamp(
        address token
    ) external view returns (uint256 price, uint256 timestamp, uint256 roundId);

    /**
     * @notice Get the Time-Weighted Average Price over a period
     * @dev Exact requested interval, requiring fresh latest data and full retained coverage.
     * New bounded observations begin on first post-upgrade update; legacy rounds remain stored.
     * @param token The token address
     * @param period The TWAP period in seconds (e.g., 300 for 5-minute TWAP)
     * @return twapPrice The TWAP with 18 decimals
     */
    function getTWAP(address token, uint256 period) external view returns (uint256 twapPrice);

    /**
     * @notice Check if a token's price is stale
     * @param token The token address
     * @return stale True if the price is older than maxStaleness
     */
    function isPriceStale(address token) external view returns (bool stale);

    /**
     * @notice Get the price decimals constant
     * @return decimals Always returns 18
     */
    // solhint-disable-next-line func-name-mixedcase
    function PRICE_DECIMALS() external pure returns (uint8 decimals);

    /**
     * @notice Get prices for multiple tokens in a single call
     * @dev Does NOT revert on stale prices — returns staleness flags instead
     * @param tokens Array of token addresses
     * @return prices Array of prices (18 decimals), 0 if not registered
     * @return timestamps Array of last update timestamps
     * @return staleFlags Array of staleness booleans
     */
    function getPrices(
        address[] calldata tokens
    )
        external
        view
        returns (uint256[] memory prices, uint256[] memory timestamps, bool[] memory staleFlags);

    /**
     * @notice Get recent price history for a token
     * @param token The token address
     * @param count Number of recent rounds to retrieve (capped at 1000)
     * @return history Array of PriceData structs (most recent first)
     */
    function getPriceHistory(
        address token,
        uint256 count
    ) external view returns (PriceData[] memory history);

    /**
     * @notice Get the latest round data for a token
     * @param token The token address
     * @return data The latest PriceData struct
     */
    function getLatestRound(address token) external view returns (PriceData memory data);

    /**
     * @notice Get a retained round (new rounds older than the latest 1000 are unavailable)
     * @param token The token address
     * @param roundId The round number to query
     * @return data The PriceData for that round
     */
    function getRoundData(
        address token,
        uint256 roundId
    ) external view returns (PriceData memory data);

    /**
     * @notice Get the configuration for a token
     * @param token The token address
     * @return config The TokenConfig struct
     */
    function getTokenConfig(address token) external view returns (TokenConfig memory config);

    /**
     * @notice Get all registered token addresses
     * @return tokens Array of registered token addresses
     */
    function getRegisteredTokens() external view returns (address[] memory tokens);

    /**
     * @notice Check if a relayer is authorized
     * @param relayer The address to check
     * @return authorized True if the relayer is authorized to push prices
     */
    function isAuthorizedRelayer(address relayer) external view returns (bool authorized);

    /**
     * @notice Update the price of a single token
     * @dev Only callable by authorized relayers. Validates against price bounds.
     * @param token The token address
     * @param price The new price (18 decimals)
     */
    function updatePrice(address token, uint256 price) external;

    /**
     * @notice Update prices for multiple tokens in a single transaction
     * @dev Primary method for relayers. Gas is free on Paxeer, so push all tokens every heartbeat.
     * @param tokens Array of token addresses
     * @param prices Array of new prices (18 decimals)
     */
    function batchUpdatePrices(address[] calldata tokens, uint256[] calldata prices) external;

    /**
     * @notice Register a new token with its oracle configuration
     * @param token The token address to register
     * @param heartbeatInterval Max seconds between updates
     * @param deviationThresholdBps Min deviation to warrant update (BPS)
     * @param minPrice Lower price bound (18 decimals)
     * @param maxPrice Upper price bound (18 decimals)
     * @param maxStaleness Seconds after which price is stale
     */
    function registerToken(
        address token,
        uint256 heartbeatInterval,
        uint256 deviationThresholdBps,
        uint256 minPrice,
        uint256 maxPrice,
        uint256 maxStaleness
    ) external;

    /**
     * @notice Update the configuration of an existing token
     * @param token The token address
     * @param config The new TokenConfig
     */
    function updateTokenConfig(address token, TokenConfig calldata config) external;

    /**
     * @notice Set the authorization status of a relayer
     * @param relayer The relayer address
     * @param authorized True to authorize, false to revoke
     */
    function setRelayer(address relayer, bool authorized) external;

    /// @notice Emergency pause; blocks price pushes (spec §7.1).
    function pause() external;

    /// @notice Resume price pushes after pause.
    function unpause() external;

    event PriceUpdated(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 indexed roundId,
        address indexed relayer,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    event BatchPriceUpdate(address indexed relayer, uint256 tokenCount, uint256 timestamp);

    event TokenRegistered(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 heartbeatInterval,
        uint256 deviationThresholdBps,
        uint256 minPrice,
        uint256 maxPrice,
        uint256 maxStaleness
    );

    event TokenConfigUpdated(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 heartbeatInterval,
        uint256 deviationThresholdBps,
        uint256 minPrice,
        uint256 maxPrice,
        uint256 maxStaleness
    );

    event RelayerUpdated(address indexed relayer, bool authorized);

    event StalePriceDetected(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 lastUpdateTimestamp,
        uint256 currentTimestamp,
        uint256 maxStaleness
    );
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title ITransactionTracker
 * @notice Interface for the Sidiora Meta-AG Transaction Tracker — event hub for PECOR-flow analytics
 * @dev Sibling to Sidiora Launchpad's EventEmitter (spec §7.12).
 *      Only authorized emitters (PECOR, PECOROrders, PECORVault, MetaAGRouter) can record.
 */
interface ITransactionTracker {

    struct DailyStats {
        uint256 totalVolume;
        uint256 totalTrades;
        uint256 uniqueTraders;
        uint256 timestamp;
    }

    struct TokenStats {
        uint256 totalVolume;
        uint256 tradeCount;
        uint256 lastTradeTimestamp;
    }

    struct UserStats {
        uint256 totalVolume;
        uint256 tradeCount;
        uint256 firstTradeTimestamp;
        uint256 lastTradeTimestamp;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Initialize the UUPS proxy (spec §7.12)
     * @param admin Timelock — granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
     */
    function initialize(address admin) external;

    /// @notice Grant / revoke EMITTER_ROLE to a contract address (spec §7.12).
    function setAuthorizedEmitter(address emitter, bool authorized) external;

    /// @notice Force a daily stats snapshot (e.g., ops-driven day rollover).
    function forceDaySnapshot() external;

    function recordTrade(
        address user,
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 volumeUSD
    ) external;

    function recordMarketTrade(
        address user,
        address stablecoin,
        address token,
        uint256 stablecoinAmount,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 executionPrice
    ) external;

    function recordLimitOrderPlaced(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        address token,
        address stablecoin,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 targetPrice,
        bool isBuy
    ) external;

    function recordLimitOrderExecuted(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        uint256 executionPrice
    ) external;

    function recordLimitOrderCancelled(uint256 orderId, address user) external;

    function recordStopLossPlaced(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        address token,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        uint256 triggerPrice
    ) external;

    function recordStopLossTriggered(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        uint256 triggerPrice,
        uint256 executionPrice,
        uint256 amountOut
    ) external;

    function recordStopLimitPlaced(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        address token,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 stopPrice,
        uint256 limitPrice,
        bool isBuy
    ) external;

    function recordStopLimitActivated(uint256 orderId, uint256 activationPrice) external;

    function recordStopLimitExecuted(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        uint256 executionPrice
    ) external;

    function recordLiquidityAdded(
        address token,
        address provider,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve
    ) external;

    function recordLiquidityRemoved(
        address token,
        address remover,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve
    ) external;

    function getDailyStats(uint256 dayTimestamp) external view returns (DailyStats memory);

    function getTokenStats(address token) external view returns (TokenStats memory);

    function getUserStats(address user) external view returns (UserStats memory);

    function getCurrentDayStats() external view returns (DailyStats memory);

    event TradeExecuted(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenIn,
        address indexed tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 volumeUSD,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event MarketTrade(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed stablecoin,
        address indexed token,
        uint256 stablecoinAmount,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 executionPrice,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event LimitOrderPlaced(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        address indexed token,
        address stablecoin,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 targetPrice,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event LimitOrderExecuted(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 executionPrice,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event LimitOrderCancelled(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event StopLossPlaced(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        address indexed token,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        uint256 triggerPrice,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event StopLossTriggered(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 triggerPrice,
        uint256 executionPrice,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event StopLimitPlaced(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        address indexed token,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 stopPrice,
        uint256 limitPrice,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event StopLimitActivated(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        uint256 activationPrice,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event StopLimitExecuted(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 executionPrice,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event LiquidityAdded(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed provider,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event LiquidityRemoved(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed remover,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event DailyStatsSnapshot(
        uint256 indexed dayTimestamp,
        uint256 totalVolume,
        uint256 totalTrades,
        uint256 uniqueTraders
    );
    event TokenVolumeUpdate(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 dailyVolume,
        uint256 totalVolume,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event VaultLiquidityUpdate(address indexed token, uint256 reserve, uint256 timestamp);
    event UserTradeMetrics(
        address indexed user,
        uint256 totalVolume,
        uint256 tradeCount,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event AuthorizedEmitterUpdated(address indexed emitter, bool authorized);
}

@title PECOROrders — Limit / Stop-Loss / Stop-Limit order engine

         PECORVault v2 at place-time and executes atomically at match-time
         via keeper-triggered pushes. Split from PECOR.sol for contract
         size and surface-area separation (spec §7.7).
 @dev Interface: `contracts/meta-ag/interfaces/IPECOROrders.sol`.
      Vault must grant OPERATOR_ROLE to this contract before placement.
 Inheritance (spec §7.7):
   IPECOROrders, Initializable, UUPSUpgradeable, AccessControl,
   ReentrancyGuard, Pausable
 Roles:
   - DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE → Timelock at deploy (invariant S1)
   - KEEPER_ROLE        → authorized keepers (rotated via {setKeeper})
 Storage layout (append-only per S12):
   slot 0:  AccessControl._roles             (mapping)
   slot 1:  priceOracle                      (address)
   slot 2:  vault                            (address)
   slot 3:  transactionTracker               (address)
   slot 4:  nextOrderId                      (uint256)
   slot 5:  limitOrders                      (mapping)
   slot 6:  stopLimitOrders                  (mapping)
   slot 7:  userLimitOrders                  (mapping)
   slot 8:  userStopLimitOrders              (mapping)
   slot 9:  activeLimitOrderIds              (uint256[])
   slot 10: activeStopLimitOrderIds          (uint256[])
   slot 11: _limitOrderActiveIndex           (mapping, 1-indexed)
   slot 12: _stopLimitOrderActiveIndex       (mapping, 1-indexed)
   slot 13: keepers                          (mapping — mirror of KEEPER_ROLE)
   slot 14..63: __gap[50]
